name: Life spaceship 83da34d9 on 3-uniform tiling k3-057
description: A period-12 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-057, with touching neighbours, 13 to 24 cells, moving one lattice step every 12 generations (c/12). It runs the same way in the 8,192 rules from B3/S23 to B3,9,10,11,12/S2,3,9,10,11,12. JETCARP's Life census met it in 57 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
